Narita Airport has been amid controversy for last 60 years, because of Sanrizuka Struggle, which began in 1966. The struggle stemmed from the government's decision to construct the airport in Sanrizuka without the involvement or consent of most area residents. There have been riots (1985), demonstrations, bombings, and destructive action against the airport from splinter groups.
Curfew is to ensure control over noise pollution for nearby residents. The farm has also been allowed to continue its operations.
